참조: [Data Visualization with ggplot2::Cheat Sheet "Themes"](https://rstudio.github.io/cheatsheets/html/data-visualization.html#themes)

#### 그래프 테마

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
r <- ggplot(mpg, aes(fl)) + geom_bar()
```

##### theme_bw()

```{r}
r + theme_bw()
```

##### theme_gray()

```{r}
r + theme_gray()
```

##### theme_dark()

```{r}
r + theme_dark()
```

##### theme_classic()

```{r}
r + theme_classic()
```

##### theme_light()

```{r}
r + theme_light()
```

##### theme_linedraw()

```{r}
r + theme_linedraw()
```

##### theme_minimal()

```{r}
r + theme_minimal()
```

##### theme_void()

```{r}
r + theme_void()
```

#### 테마 사용자화

- theme() 함수를 사용하여 axis, legend, panel, facet 같은 속성을 설정

```{r}
r + labs(title = "Title") + theme(plot.title.position = "plot")
```

```{r}
r + theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "blue"))
```
